scheme_name: Scheme for Supply of Male Goat on Subsidy Basis
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be actively involved in goat rearing
Applicant must be a goat rearer of any category
Applicant must possess a minimum of 5 goats
benefits_summary: One improved‑breed male goat (valued at ₹8,300) provided on a 75% grant, including insurance, mineral mixture, training booklet and monitoring card.
application_link: Contact the nearest Veterinary Officer of the concerned District Incharge of Animal Dispensary / Deputy Director of Veterinary for application approvals.
